objective: Improve state-witness processing in the pinned Ethereum block-proving pipeline. Preserve accepted computation and proof security settings. Deliver a reusable module with a machine-checked optimization property and documented integration. Meet the frozen prover-gas (PGU) acceptance gate on the sealed holdout set. Latency and cost are measured and reported separately; neither is a gate.

integrationTarget.supportedFork: Cancun era in full (blocks 19426587 to 22431083). Prague and Osaka rules execute (blocks 22441128, 23945771 and 25988970 pass), but the pinned host rejects any block carrying an EIP-7702 authorization of a nonexistent authority (apparatus/FAILURES.md #10), so holdout blocks are drawn from the Cancun era
integrationTarget.proofMode: compressed (SP1 core proof); Groth16 wrap for on-chain verification
integrationTarget.hardware: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runner, 4 vCPU, 16 GB, SP1 cpu prover; see apparatus/pins.json
integrationTarget.stateBackend: proofs (eth_getProof); execution-witness is unavailable on the pinned RPC provider

workloadRelation: Ethereum mainnet block execution proofs (RSP guest, one block per proof) in the supported Cancun-era range; the public development corpus and the sealed holdout are drawn from that range, the holdout as ten consecutive blocks (evaluation/holdout/RULE.md); the counterfactual is the registered upstream arena backend (demand/registry-snapshot.json)
allowedSourcePaths: crates/executor/client/src/executor.rs (cfg-gated backend blocks only, lines 50-75 and 130-142 at the pin)
bin/client/src/main.rs (stdin reading only, lines 20-33 at the pin)
crates/executor/host/src/host_executor.rs (witness encoding only, lines 252-258 at the pin)
crates/executor/host/src/full_executor.rs (build_stdin only, lines 66-75 at the pin)
Cargo.toml (workspace members and workspace.dependencies entries for a new crate only, reviewed)
Cargo.lock (the resulting lock, reviewed against the manifest's dependencyVersions)
integrationInterface: Implement rsp_mpt::StateTries (crates/mpt/src/lib.rs:442 at the pin) for the new representation and wire its construction exactly as the upstream `arena` feature is wired (guest: io.rs, executor.rs, bin/client; host: host_executor.rs encoding from EthereumState, full_executor.rs stdin), behind one cargo feature declared on bin/host and bin/client and forwarded to the guest by bin/host/build.rs. The unchanged lemma-prove wrapper built with that feature is the integration; the evaluator derives the guest key from its own build. See apparatus/INTERFACES.md sections 2, 5 and 6.

freshReuseInput.note: recorded before any execution; disjoint from development by membership and from holdout set 1 by the frozen exclusion margin (reuse/input.py)

performanceGate.metric: prover gas units (PGU) per holdout block from SP1 execute mode, per evaluation/policy.json performance
performanceGate.statistic: median over paired holdout blocks of the per-block PGU improvement percent, 100 * (baseline - candidate) / baseline
performanceGate.definedIn: evaluation/policy.json performance.acceptance; the policy text is authoritative for the computation

reportedNotGated: median complete-job preparation+proving+wrapping wall time on the shared runner (the 0.1-draft latencyTarget, kept as an outcome)
network proof latency and PROVE cost for the real proofs
procurement economics: fee, search, download, checking, integration, compute and allocated settlement, cold and warm access separately
acceptanceCriteria.note: 0.1-draft gated on latency while the evaluator policy gated on PGU. 0.2-draft makes PGU the single technical gate (BUILD_CASE_MAP.md F0 item 2). A PGU pass is a technical result; it is not a latency or dollar claim.

resourceLimits.note: per execution job, per build and per proof on the 16 GB runner (evaluation/policy.json performance.limits); measured peak resident set 7.5 to 8.8 GB for every execute run of the corpus

candidateBundle.layout: one commit of this repository holding candidate/ (module, adapter, tests, build recipe, manifest.json) and formal/; RSP changes as an overlay under candidate/rsp/ mirroring the pinned tree, applied by evaluation/overlay.py within allowedSourcePaths
candidateBundle.featureName: the candidate declares one cargo feature on bin/host and bin/client (forwarded to the guest by bin/host/build.rs) and names it in manifest.json; apparatus-build.yml builds variant=<that name> with overlay_ref=<that commit>
candidateBundle.artifactDigest: sha256 tree hash over candidate/ and formal/ at that commit (sorted `<path> <sha256>` lines), submitted onchain and recomputed by the evaluator

sp1Verifier.note: sp1-contracts ships no deployment for 46630; we deploy and source-verify it (ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_PROD.md section 2)

settlement.guestPublicValuesBind: settlementChainId = 46630 and the UsageEscrow address, so a proof for one venue cannot settle on another (I-V1)

crossCheck.role: read-only verification of the same (vkey, publicValues, proof) triple; never a settlement venue and never funded

revisionHistory.note: step 3 fields: integration target, allowed paths, development corpus

changes: acceptance: PGU gate replaces the latency target; latency and cost reported, not gated
settlement: Robinhood Chain testnet 46630 for every funded transaction; Arbitrum Sepolia gateway kept as read-only cross-check
freshReuseInput: block 20600928 recorded in reuse/input.json (20600066 is a development block)
step 5: baselineCommit, dependencyLockHash (build 35122594072 Cargo.lock), toolchainManifestHash (evaluation/toolchain.json), workloadRelation, resourceLimits, candidateBundle
